description: A unified benchmarking framework for cooperative autonomous driving with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) capabilities, extending OpenCDA's full-stack simulation platform with distributed training infrastructure for intelligent multi-agent driving policies under CARLA+SUMO co-simulation.
